SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FOUNDATION FOLLOWS GAAP RELATED TO THE RECOGNITION OF UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS. THE FOUNDATION RECOGNIZES ACCRUED INTEREST AND PENALTIES ASSOCIATED WITH UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AS PART OF THE CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF ACTIVITIES AND CHANGES IN NET ASSETS, WHEN APPLICABLE. MANAGEMENT HAS DETERMINED THAT THE FOUNDATION HAS NO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS AT JUNE 30, 2024 AND 2023, AND NO AMOUNTS HAVE BEEN ACCRUED. THE FOUNDATION FILES INFORMATIONAL AND INCOME TAX RETURNS IN THE UNITED STATES AND VARIOUS STATE AND LOCAL JURISDICTIONS.
